ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Communication.Relations
ModMetaData.author: yancy
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Communication.Relations adds AI-driven faction diplomacy and pawn dialogue to the RimAI family.
Features: • Faction diplomacy and intelligent dialogue • Dynamic world news • Storyteller-compatible event triggering
Gameplay text AI uses the shared RimAI configuration. PackageId is unchanged for save compatibility.
